name: luxury-fur-suit-male-model
image_purpose: menswear lookbook and luxury editorial styling reference

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic studio fashion portrait of one approved adult male model in a luxury layered menswear look, preserving his facial features and facial structure.
prompt.main_subject: Adult man with intense confident gaze, thick brows, light stubble, slicked-back dark hair, and approved-reference facial features. He wears a dark navy pinstripe suit, white shirt, beige striped tie, oversized brown fur coat draped over the shoulders, chunky sneakers, and dark monster-style sunglasses as a playful accessory.
composition_elements: Subject in a low seated squat with hands resting naturally on the knees.
Preserve the contrast between tailored pinstripe suiting, oversized fur, sneakers, and sunglasses.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting, clean white environment, sharp subject focus, natural shadows, cinematic realism, and premium editorial finish.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens look, 4:5 aspect ratio, ultra-realistic detailed textures in fabric, fur, leather, and footwear, realistic anatomy and hands, high-resolution photorealistic fashion photography.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic studio fashion portrait of an adult man squatting, intense confident gaze, thick brows, light stubble, slicked-back dark hair. Wearing a dark navy pinstripe suit, white shirt, beige striped tie, oversized brown fur coat draped over shoulders, chunky sneakers and dark monster-style sunglasses. Centered composition, full-body, straight-on angle. Clean white seamless background, soft diffused studio lighting, sharp focus, high texture detail, editorial luxury fashion vibe, 85mm lens look, natural skin texture, cinematic realism. Preserve his approved-reference facial features, facial structure and details. Aspect ratio 4:5.
